title: separate consequential
rule: Do not place highly consequential or destructive actions directly next to benign confirmatory options.

citation.source: NN/g — Dangerous UX: Consequential Options Close to Benign Options

pass_when: Highly consequential or destructive actions are not directly next to benign confirmatory options.
fail_when: Destructive sits in the same tight cluster as benign confirm/save.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
